focus: 今天的重點：看時鐘說四十五分、聽標價（seventy-five 和 fifty-seven）、Where…?、How old…?、聽物品描述和電話留言找細節、讀游泳池公告、Are there 問句、用 or 連接問句。
notes: 聽力第 2 題：seventy-five（75）和 fifty-seven（57）的數字順序相反，容易聽混。可以在家說幾個兩位數，請 Kyro 寫下來。
閱讀詞彙第 3 題：兩隻小貓是「很多個」，要用 them（他們），不能用 it。可以指著兩樣東西問 Kyro：I like ____.
寫作第 1 題：There are… 改成問句，要把 are 移到最前面：Are there three eggs in the box? 句尾記得問號。

listen.q: What time does the movie start?
listen.why: 長針指著 9 是 45 分，短針在 9 和 10 中間：九點四十五分 nine forty-five。

listen.q: How much is the red bag?
listen.why: 標價是 75：seventy-five dollars。fifty-seven 是 57，數字順序相反。

talk: Where do you put your shoes, Kyro?
listen.why: Where 問「在哪裡」，要回答地點：By the door（在門旁邊）。They're black 是顏色。

talk: How old is your cat, Kyro?
listen.why: How old 問「幾歲」，要回答年紀：She is three（三歲）。white 是顏色。

talk: Kyro, my birthday party is on Sunday. Can you come?
listen.q: What will Kyro bring to the party?
listen.why: 女孩說 Please bring some cookies：請 Kyro 帶一些餅乾來。

talk: Mom, can I go to the park now?
No, Kyro. It is rainy now. Let's go after lunch.
OK. I can read a book first.
listen.why: 媽媽說 It is rainy now：現在在下雨，所以先不去公園。

talk: Look at my new toy. It is small and yellow. It has four wheels. It can go fast on the floor. I play with it every day.
listen.why: Kyro 說 It has four wheels：有四個輪子，可以在地上跑很快，是玩具小汽車。

talk: Hi, Kane. This is Ms. Lee. Our class will go to the park tomorrow. Please bring an umbrella. It may be rainy. See you at eight.
listen.why: 李老師說 Please bring an umbrella：明天可能下雨，要帶雨傘。

vocab.stem: This ice cream is cold and ____. I like it!
vocab.why: 冰淇淋又冰又甜：sweet（甜的）。tall 是高的，slow 是慢的。

vocab.stem: The little fish can ____ in the green plants. The big fish can't see it.
vocab.why: 小魚躲在水草裡，大魚就看不到：hide（躲藏），是學校 LA 的單字。

vocab.stem: I have two kittens. I play with ____ every day.
vocab.why: 兩隻小貓是很多個，要用 them（他們）。it 只能指一個。

cloze.passage: Dear Kane, I am at the farm with Grandpa. It is cloudy today. Grandpa {1} three cows and many ducks. I feed the ducks every morning. They are white and very cute. There is a big pond {2} the house. See you soon! Kyro

items.why: Grandpa 是一個人（他），「有」要用 has：Grandpa has three cows。
池塘在房子的旁邊：next to the house。

text.intro: 讀下面游泳池的公告，回答三個問題。
text.title: Sunny Park Pool

items.stem: How much is it for kids?
items.why: Kids: 30 dollars：小朋友 30 元，thirty。thirteen 是 13。

items.stem: What must you wear in the pool?
items.why: Please wear a swim cap：要戴泳帽。

write.prompt: There are three eggs in the box.
accept: are there three eggs in the box
write.model: Are there three eggs in the box?
near: ^there are three eggs in the box$
問句要把 Are 放到最前面：Are there…?
三顆蛋是很多個，要用 Are there。
問句要用 Are 開頭。
hints: Are there three ___ in the box?

write.instr: 用 or 把兩個問句合成一句。
accept: is the frog green or brown
is the frog green or is the frog brown
write.model: Is the frog green or brown?
near: 問「哪一個」要用 or，不是 and。
問「哪一個」要用 or，不是 but。
green 和 brown 中間要加 or。
hints: 兩個選一個，用 or 連起來。

write.instr: 依照順序點字卡，排成一句話。
hints: 大寫字母開頭的字放第一個，有句點的字放最後。
短針在 7 和 8 中間、長針指 6：seven thirty；太陽出來是 sunny。
